name: 洪媽益
objective:
本課程可以提供對語法句型的形式、語意和使用有更深入的了解，並且更理解語言與語法如何教學與學習，以獲得知識與能力，來設計與發展學習教材，訓練懂得妥善使用語言的第二語言學習者。
The course will allow students to gain a deeper insight into the form, meaning, and use of grammatical constructions, as well as how grammar is taught and learned, which will help them acquire the knowledge and expertise to design lessons and develop materials that can foster the growth of L2 learners as linguistically competent individuals.
